row: My name is Sophie McMurrough and I am a Registered Veterinary Nurse and a Veterinary Technician Specialist in Small Animal Internal Medicine (one of only 11 in the UK). I am an international speaker and regularly deliver CPD to other vet professionals across the globe. This channel aims to provide hints and tips on many nursing topics including nurse clinics, clinical skills and useful info to use in practice. Please follow me on FB/IG - Veterinary Nurse Medicine Geek!
